title: TEST ONLY — Zombie Cat Apocalypse RPG
profile: Complete beginner; asks for small runnable changes and resists complete solutions.
goal: Help a kitten escape zombie cats with sentient AI mice while learning Python gradually.

sessions.title: A choice is a string
sessions.learner_prediction: Any non-empty choice means the player chose hide.
sessions.observation: The condition if choice: also accepts 'run'.

decision.choice: Use explicit equality for the first branch
decision.reason: The learner can predict two inputs before introducing additional structure.

sessions.next_action: Predict hide and run paths, then run both.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: The mouse gives back nothing
sessions.learner_prediction: If I see 3 printed then the function returned 3.
sessions.learner_attempt: Write a function that prints a damage value and assign its call to health.
sessions.observation: The printed value is 3, but the assigned result is None.
sessions.correction: A display effect differs from a return value.

decision.choice: Separate computing damage from narrating it
decision.reason: This creates a reusable function without introducing classes.

sessions.unresolved: Do not supply a complete combat engine.
sessions.next_action: Add one explicit return and inspect the caller value.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: An inventory disappears
sessions.learner_prediction: Each call gets a new list because it is a new game.
sessions.learner_attempt: Call start_game twice with a mutable default inventory.
sessions.observation: A ration picked up in the first call appears in the second.
sessions.correction: A default list is created once at function definition; create fresh state per game.

decision.choice: Use an explicit state dictionary returned by a factory
decision.reason: Two independent states make the aliasing test concrete.

sessions.unresolved: Classes are optional and deferred, not forbidden forever.
sessions.next_action: Create two games, mutate one inventory and inspect both.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: Save data is not trusted code
sessions.learner_prediction: Any parsed JSON is a valid game save.
sessions.learner_attempt: Save JSON state, reload it, then try a file missing health.
sessions.observation: JSON syntax accepts the file but required fields are absent.
sessions.correction: Syntax validity does not prove game-state validity.

decision.choice: Validate a minimal versioned save contract
decision.reason: The learner can inspect missing keys before learning a class hierarchy.

sessions.unresolved: No class refactor or complete game has been implemented.
sessions.next_action: Write a failing missing-health check, then repair loading without resetting a valid inventory.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.
